text:
I'm sorry your new plant is looking unwell. Yellowing of one or two older, lower leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress, so it isn't covered for a replacement on its own.

For now, keep it out of direct sun for the first week, don't repot for 2-3 weeks, and water only when the top inch of soil is dry (overwatering is the most common cause).

If it gets significantly worse, you can submit a claim from "My Orders" within 30 days of delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members). Significant decline means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse. Include at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up), and a Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days. You can also chat or email a Plant Care Specialist for free care advice anytime.
